annotations.text:
HOMEPAGE MODERNIZATION — three directions, same palette (green/gold/cream) and type stack (Cormorant Garamond + EB Garamond)
Pick one to build out, or mix elements (e.g. B's card structure with A's ornament level).

A · Refined Manuscript
Closest to the current site — same green panels, gilt lines, arch motifs — but tightened spacing, a frosted sticky header, softer single-line borders instead of double gilt, and a real CTA in the hero.
Lowest risk, most familiar to rebuild from the existing CSS.

B · Modern Bento
Restructures the page into a modular card grid (SaaS-style), cream header instead of green, and pairs the display serif with Manrope for UI text/labels.
Biggest structural change — most new components to build, but reads the most 'current'.

C · Minimal Illuminated
Strips almost all ornament to typography, one thin gold rule, and generous whitespace — an editorial/luxury feel. No cards, no green fills except a hairline.
Highest risk if the masjid wants the page to feel more 'produced'; best if they want it to feel calmer and more premium.
